title: Niagara Magic Live
includes: Admission Ticket to the 90-minute Magic Show
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Tiered level seating; all with unobstructed views
Guests are encouraged to arrive between 7pm and 7:15pm for a 7:30pm showtime
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Magic… the International Language! Step into a world of wonder with Niagara Magic Live, a high-energy magic show starring International Grand Champion Greg Frewin and Canada’s Lady of Magic, Alexandra. Held in the heart of Niagara Falls, Ontario, this 90-minute performance features a stunning mix of grand illusions, sleight-of-hand, and a captivating storyline that will leave audiences inspired.

Designed for all ages, this family-friendly experience welcomes kids, parents, and grandparents alike. Whether you're on a romantic getaway or a small to large group outing, Niagara Magic Live offers something for everyone.

Enjoy the show from a variety of seating options in a spacious 550-seat, wheelchair-accessible theatre. Ask our Box Office about adding a Buffet Dinner before the show. Concessions, a licensed bar, and a Magic Shop are available at every performance.

Recognized by the International Brotherhood of Magicians, Niagara Magic Live is the best must-see attraction in Niagara.
